about: Curated sample sites for tools/osm. Build with: python3 -m sitepack build-all. Plot specs are described in README.md.

sites.name: Milton Keynes centre car park
sites.description: A surface car park wedged between a shopping centre and the grid roads. Flat and firm, but hemmed in.

sites.name: Northstowe meadow
sites.description: An open greenfield meadow on the edge of a new town in the Cambridgeshire flatlands. Plenty of room for a big building.

sites.name: Northstowe field under power lines
sites.description: A flat farm field plot with overhead power lines running across it. Easy ground, but cranes must work around the wires.

sites.name: Bath hillside garage block
sites.description: A lock-up garage block on one of Bath's steep hillsides, among listed terraces. Clear the garages, then build a house on a hard slope.

sites.name: Tewkesbury riverside car park
sites.description: A car park in a town that floods, between the Avon and the Mill Avon. Flat, but the ground is soft and wet.

sites.name: Ancoats city infill
sites.description: A small gap site among Manchester's old mills and new flats. Cramped, made ground, neighbours on the boundary.

sites.name: Phoenix Ironworks, Ancoats
sites.description: A large former ironworks site in central Manchester. Room for a big building, but it is made ground with neighbours close by.

sites.name: Camden Town infill
sites.description: A tiny construction gap by Camden Town station. Very little room, busy roads and the Underground underneath.

sites.name: Clovelly cliffside cottage
sites.description: A cottage on a Devon fishing village's cobbled street, which drops steeply to the harbour. No vehicle road reaches it: clear the old cottage and rebuild with everything carried in.

sites.name: Manston airfield
sites.description: A former airport's runway on the Kent coast. A huge, flat, open site for a terminal, but every delivery needs a haul road across the old airfield.

sites.name: Middlehaven dockside
sites.description: Open former dock land by the Tees in Middlesbrough. Room for a big building, on made and wet ground.

sites.name: Addenbrooke's hospital car park
sites.description: A small car park squeezed between hospital buildings. A hospital wing has to fit around the wards next door.

sites.name: Hebden Bridge, Garden Street
sites.description: A town centre car park in a steep, narrow Pennine valley, beside a river that floods.

sites.name: York Castle Gateway
sites.description: A construction plot by York's castle and the River Foss. Flood risk, buried history and listed neighbours.

sites.name: Shaftesbury hillside
sites.description: Scrubland below Gold Hill, one of England's steepest streets. Room for a school, if you can terrace the slope.

sites.name: Robin Hood's Bay clifftop
sites.description: Scrub on the steep slope above a Yorkshire fishing village, reached only by lanes too tight for big lorries.

sites.name: Edinburgh, Parliament Square
sites.description: A car park on the Royal Mile, surrounded by some of Scotland's most protected buildings.

sites.name: Cambourne centre car park
sites.description: A new town's car park on flat Cambridgeshire clay. Plenty of access: a gentle plot to start on.

sites.name: Liverpool warehouse clearance
sites.description: An old building in south Liverpool to knock down and replace. Demolition first, then build.

sites.name: Sheffield city centre gap
sites.description: A tiny construction gap in Sheffield's centre, between shops and offices.

sites.name: Glasgow allotments
sites.description: Allotments in Glasgow's West End. Flat and roomy, but the trees and neighbours need care.
